references.text: Earlier in the same chapter, the Lord describes how he struck the enemies with great confusion and hail, leading to the great defeat mentioned in verse 20.
A similar pattern where Joshua and Israel struck the enemies with a great blow until no survivors were left.
God's command to strike the enemies completely, fulfilled in Joshua's battle against the five kings.
Israel struck Og, king of Bashan, along with all his people until no survivors were left - the same expression of complete victory.
A similar description of how Israel struck all the inhabitants of Ai out in the open field.
Joshua struck Horam, king of Gezer, and his people until no survivors were left.
